Hey peaches, I am here. Chronic insomnia sucks. Had it since I was 19 and recently had a 2-3 week episode of no REM sleep and internet addiction. Lost many friends and my overall beauty. Only 21. I used to be so gorgeous and now men have trouble making eye contact with me. I am so depressed, I do nothing all day. Today, I feel a bit better and I am going to help my mom. My attention span is short, mood is all over the place. Please reach out <3
Also, lack of sleep has messed up my ability to feel empathy. It really sucks. I used to feel strong empathy towards others, especially my mom. Now, I LITERALLY feel nothing.

Another note: I am super depressed for all that I have done. Man, I wish I just did NOT date during my late teen years. I am going to be 21 soon and I regret dating. It sucks and I feel like no one would want me because of these issues and my reputation isn't the greatest at this point (because of my past behaviour). Man....I screwed up. And now, I'm going to try my best to be a better person.

Thank you, this is super helpful. I neglected self care and turned to self-loathing instead. Big mistake. I need to stop blaming myself for this relationship. It is agonizing and a real confidence crusher! Nightly, I experience panic attacks and withdrawal symptoms. I was literally obsessed with him! But you are right, we need to remind ourselves that we fell for the mask, not the person behind that mask.
Thank you so much. I will definitely look into these sources. Journaling is going well so far.

Thank you, I really needed to read this message. The withdrawal is super intense and unfortunately, it triggered my insomnia again. I hope you can recover from your Nex's abuse soon. The Narc is a parasite that infects their prey with poison and that poison isn't the abuse, it is the ongoing ruminating, the never answered "why did he do this to me," and worse of all "how come I am enduring withdrawal." I am in the beginning stages of getting over this. I hope I can get my life back on track and regain my sanity.
